question: Could you calculate the average of the total runs scored by all strikers who have scored more than 50 runs in any single match?
sql:
-- Step 1: Find all striker-player_id pairs who scored > 50 in at least one match
-- Step 2: For those players, compute their total runs across ALL matches
-- Step 3: Average those totals

WITH striker_match_runs AS (
  SELECT b.striker, b.match_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
  FROM ball_by_ball b
  INNER JOIN batsman_scored bs 
    ON b.match_id = bs.match_id 
    AND b.over_id = bs.over_id 
    AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
    AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
  GROUP BY b.striker, b.match_id
),
qualifying_strikers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT striker
  FROM striker_match_runs
  WHERE total_runs > 50
)
SELECT AVG(smr.total_runs) as avg_total_runs
FROM striker_match_runs smr
INNER JOIN qualifying_strikers qs ON smr.striker = qs.striker

  FROM ball_by_ball b
  INNER JOIN batsman_scored bs 
    ON b.match_id = bs.match_id 
    AND b.over_id = bs.over_id 
    AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
    AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
  GROUP BY b.striker, b.match_id
),
qualifying_strikers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT striker
  FROM striker_match_runs
  WHERE total_runs > 50
)
SELECT AVG(smr.total_runs) as avg_total_runs
FROM striker_match_runs smr
INNER JOIN qualifying_strikers qs ON smr.striker = qs.striker
